description: Business days whose SOFR first print was not kept by its revision instant (14:30 ET on the publication day) and is lost: the capture never back-fills a day (#940, #1404). The confirmation's missing-outcome rule (#1393, rule 8) counts these days. One entry per effective date, with the reason. Added by a pull request after the run history shows the loss; `python3 scripts/sofr_first_print.py missing` fails on a day that is lost and not listed, and on a listed day that has a file.
